testsuite.name: io.libp2p.network.NetworkRetirementTerminationTest

testcase.name: retirement reaches a terminal outcome when the parent closes without a reply()
retirement reaches a terminal outcome when the peer resets without a reply()
a denied retirement preserves eligibility of its live parent()
retirement reaches a terminal outcome when the peer ends writing without a reply()
